scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/ui-showcase/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @morydeals/worker && npm run typecheck -w @morydeals/browser-service && npm run typecheck -w @morydeals/api && npm run typecheck -w @morydeals/mobile
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/ui/test/*.test.mts && npm test -w @morydeals/worker && npm test -w @morydeals/api && npm test -w @morydeals/mobile
scripts.check: npm run tokens:check -w @morydeals/ui && npm run lint -w @morydeals/worker && npm run format:check -w @morydeals/worker && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint -w @morydeals/api && npm run format:check -w @morydeals/api
